name: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
notes: ASR measures predicted coordinates inside an annotated target or compromised generated content; actual clicks, environment changes and downstream harm are not verified. SCR additionally counts adopted adversarial intent or task/schema disruption. Clean-task and attacked-trajectory denominators differ, including 42 clean desktop tasks versus 209 adversarial desktop trajectories. Payloads and injection points are fixed, and neutral prompts change both compliance cues and instruction-priority guidance. GPT-5 judging has a 300-trajectory human-label check, with borderline disagreements. Android-style mobile dialogs do not establish an Android runtime. Code/data links were identified but not inspected; no independent reproduction.
summary: Builds trajectory-guided visual-injection tests for web, desktop and mobile observations, separating target-matching action predictions from broader semantic compromise.
